neighbours.label: Comeback / resurgence: something that had ended, faded or gone away is returning or being revived (a band reuniting, an illness recurring, a show or fashion brought back, a politician re-entering). Fires on the return word and, often more strongly, on the token just before it where the context sets up the return. Not a physical trip back to a place, and not the word 'back' in other senses.
fire: Twenty years after their breakup, the Swedish pop group is back with a new album.
Doctors warned that the infection could come back if she stopped the antibiotics early.
Film cameras, once nearly extinct, are making a comeback with young photographers.
The studio has revived the detective series that was cancelled in 2009.
After a long slump, the striker returned to form with two goals on Saturday.
Wolves, wiped out in the region a century ago, have finally returned to the valley.
The former senator, who resigned in disgrace, is attempting a political comeback.
Polio, which had been eliminated in the country, has re-emerged in two northern provinces.
quiet: This year the Swedish pop group is releasing a new album with a different producer.
Doctors warned that the infection could spread if she stopped the antibiotics early.
Film cameras are popular with young photographers who like the grainy look.
The studio has cancelled the detective series that began airing in 2009.
After a long season, the striker scored two goals on Saturday.
Wolves, common in the northern forests, are now protected in the valley.
The former senator, who resigned in disgrace, is now writing a memoir.
Polio vaccination rates have risen sharply in two northern provinces.

predictions: 7/8 fire, 0-1 near misses fire. Weakest fire candidates: the striker returning to form and the wolves (closest to a physical return).
notes: Exploration (bands scan of 2000 windows plus throwaway probes, not reused here): sparse, 220 of 2.05M tokens reach 0.3 of max. Only 4% of ' back'/' again' tokens reach 0.15, and 'back' as a body part or location, 'again' as plain repetition, and going back to a place for keys or lunch all score about 0. The pole is anticipatory: in 'After six years apart, the two bandmates are ...' the token ' are' scores 0.62 even when the sentence then says they are NOT reunited, so near misses here drop the set-up of a prior ending as well as the return itself.
